summary: The "SiteWebsites" module is a web user control that manages website entries for a specific site. It provides functionalities for adding, editing, deleting, and displaying website data in a grid format.
purpose: To manage and display website entries related to a specific site, allowing for CRUD operations through a user interface.

fields.name: fvwWebsite
fields.description: Form view control for displaying website details.

fields.name: gvwWebsites
fields.description: Grid view control for listing websites.

fields.name: pnlEmptyData
fields.description: Panel displayed when no data is available.

fields.name: dsWebsites
fields.description: Object data source for retrieving website data.

workflows.name: Website Management
steps: Display websites in a grid view.
Allow users to add a new website entry.
Enable editing of existing website entries.
Display website details in a form view.

validations: Ensure UserSession is active before allowing data operations.
system_behavior: Switch to edit mode when editing a website.
Show 'no data found' panel if no websites are listed and the screen is editable.
Bind data to grid and form view controls.
dependencies: Relies on HSPnet framework and data layer for session and data operations.
exceptions: Cancel data retrieval if UserSession is null.
